project_name: Northwind Commerce - Unified Retail Analytics Harness (DEMO)

1_requirements.notes: Interview held 2026-09-09. Intake doc: northwind-commerce-discovery.md. 6 sources, Databricks lakehouse target. 5 open questions, 2 resolved same day via /finalize-requirements (GA4 via extract job; gold_pii same catalog).

2_architecture.notes: Design produced 2026-09-09. ELT on Databricks (bronze/silver/gold Delta), dbt Core + dbt-databricks, Terraform (databricks/aws/google providers), Dagster orchestration, GitHub Actions CI/CD with plan/apply + dbt build + manual promotion. Hard reconciliation gate as a Dagster asset check. 3 open design decisions carried into build.

3_build_and_test.notes: Build plan (9 components, lowest-dependency-first) + one buildsheet per component + dbt-project-scaffold + fixtures-catalog + local-dev guide. Scaffolded build/repo/ (152 files): Python 3.12 extractors for the 6 sources + common/ (config, state, secrets, landing, manifest, base, http, dbt_runner); recon/ publish/ lineage/ obs/; the dbt project (39 model stubs across staging/intermediate/marts + 4 snapshots + 5 seeds + 5 macros + 5 tests) with a DuckDB ci target; 14 skipped unit-test stubs; tiny synthetic fixtures; Makefile + pyproject + pre-commit. Stubs + TODO bodies only - Python compiles, dbt/config YAML parses. 4 open items (O1-O4); O2/O3 tied to Q3/Q4.

deliverables: build/repo/ (+43 files scaffolded: northwind_dagster/, infra/, .github/workflows/, CODEOWNERS)
4_pipeline_and_git.notes: 7 pipeline docs + skeletons. northwind_dagster/ code location (package NOT named `dagster` to avoid shadowing the lib): 6 ingest assets + @dbt_assets curated_build + publish/catalog_register/advance_watermarks/emit_metrics + reconcile as a blocking @asset_check; schedules per 07 cron, pos_s3_sensor, backfill.py, deployment.yaml (var.mode cloud_agent|oss_selfhost = Q3). infra/ Terraform: bootstrap/ (S3+DynamoDB state) + 6 modules (warehouse, storage, orchestrator, ga4, ci, observability) + envs/{dev,stg,prd} dir-per-env; providers pinned; values are var refs/TODO. .github/workflows/{pr,main,promote,drift}.yml with OIDC, self-hosted runners, stg 1-approver / prd 2-approver + Tue/Thu window. Extended .pre-commit-config.yaml + CODEOWNERS + config/<env>.generated.yml.example + schedule block in defaults.yml + pyproject [orchestration] extra. Python compiles; YAML parses. terraform fmt/validate NOT run (not installed; it is a pre-commit + pr.yml gate). Open: Q3 (mode default cloud_agent), Q2 (backfill depth = runtime param), Q4 (dbt-only, carried).

5_full_testing_and_hardening.notes: 10 hardening docs. Test pyramid unit/data/contract/integration(I1-I7)/e2e(E1-E8); 80% cov gate. DQ matrix DQ01-DQ15 covering every requirements/04 rule + thresholds (0.5% fail / 0.1% warn per business date) + freshness + schema-drift. Reconciliation fixtures R1-R8 (row-count, GMV control totals per channel, refund linkage, order=lines, FX coverage, dup keys, distribution drift 30/60, PII leak) each PASS/FAIL/boundary + gate action + report + replay assertions. CI gates: merge adds contract+integration-subset+iac-scan(checkov/tfsec)+fail-on-critical pip-audit; promote prd needs security sign-off + empty drift + change window. Observability: 12 metrics, 4 dashboards, alert table A1-A12 -> PagerDuty/Slack mapped to 07/09, 6 SLOs. Security review: 9 findings - F1 gold_pii row filter+column mask not implemented (High), F2 Databricks secret scopes+ACLs not in IaC (High, = /validate-config #5), F3 catalog-wide SP grants, F4 empty CI IAM policy, F5 orchestrator SG egress 0.0.0.0/0, F6 retention/lifecycle vs 08 mismatch, F7 no RTBF impl/drill, F8 supply chain (unpinned, no lockfile), F9 DynamoDB/ECS encryption. Runbook: normal day, per-alert + per-recon-check triage, backfill, 5 rollback procedures. Go-live: 18 readiness items, 6 drills (backfill/rollback/failure/RTBF/DR/peak-load), cutover + rollback plan. Carries Phase 4 /validate-config gaps #5->F2 and #15->DQ14/DQ15/go-live item 6. Open: Q3 Dagster Cloud SaaS review (go-live item 17), Q2 backfill depth, Q4 wholesale grain (go-live item 18). Specs only - nothing run/deployed.
